enabled.description: Render the AGE-on-CNPG `Cluster` (templates/age-cluster.yaml); mutually exclusive with `age.enabled`. Needs an extension image, K8s 1.33+ and the CloudNativePG operator (>= 1.27), a prerequisite: the render refuses on a cluster that does not serve postgresql.cnpg.io/v1.

extensionImage.description: The built AGE extension image for the CNPG cluster (e.g. ghcr.io/<org>/age-cnpg-ext:1.7.0-18); required when `cnpgCluster.enabled`, no default.

enabled.description: Run the in-cluster apache/age Postgres StatefulSet that serves the lineage graph, OpenFGA and the Dapr state store databases.

externalHost.description: Postgres host lineage, OpenFGA and the Dapr state store use instead of the in-cluster AGE; the render refuses it empty with age.enabled=false.

image.description: Postgres+AGE image for the StatefulSet and the pg_dump backup job (PG16; 1.6.0 is multi-arch amd64+arm64).

lineageDb.description: Name of the AGE graph and database holding the OpenLineage graph.

openfgaDb.description: Name of the database OpenFGA uses as its datastore.

port.description: Postgres port of the AGE store, used by every client DSN, the backup job and the network policy.

stateDb.description: Name of the database the Dapr Postgres state store owns and migrates itself.

storage.description: PVC size of the AGE StatefulSet. Immutable after install: the chart fails an upgrade that changes it (see docs/runbooks/RUNBOOK-restore.md).

user.description: Postgres user every AGE client connects as; its password is the store's `postgres-password` secret, never a value.

arenaMax.description: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX set on every lakehouse container (lance.allocatorEnv) to cap glibc malloc arenas. Default 2.

arrowMemoryPool.description: ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL on every lakehouse container; `system` routes Arrow through malloc so `arenaMax` bounds it.

allowHeadless.description: Permit `auth.enabled` without a frontend sign-in flow, for a deliberately API-only estate; otherwise templates/auth-consistency.yaml refuses that combination.

audit.description: Emit the structured authn/authz/credential-vending audit stream (LANCE_AUDIT_ENABLED and siblings); takes effect only with auth on. false silences it.

bootstrapAdmin.description: Dex subject (id_token `sub`) the bootstrap-admin hook grants `owner` on the default warehouse and `admin` on estate:rask. Empty = human grants are made out of band.

enabled.description: Govern the estate: authn on every door plus OpenFGA authz. On by default (fails closed); a bare install then needs frontend OIDC configured or it refuses to render.

externalFgaClients.description: ServiceAccounts outside this release that OpenFGA admits, each `<namespace>:<name>` (e.g. `default:rask-sa-compute` for the compute fixture). Read only with auth on.

fgaApiUrl.description: The platform's OpenFGA HTTP API (e.g. `https://fga.internal:8080`), which every FGA client, the openfga-model hook and the bootstrap-admin Job dial when `openfga.enabled` is false; the render refuses it empty then. It must admit rask's projected `rask-openfga` tokens: OIDC against the cluster's ServiceAccount issuer, the subjects `lance.openfgaSubjects` lists.

fgaModelId.description: Pin the OpenFGA authorization model id every service checks against, whatever its image carries. Empty = the store's latest model.

fgaStoreId.description: Pin the OpenFGA store id used by every service, the openfga-model hook and the bootstrap-admin Job. Empty = the newest store named `lance-catalog`.

enabled.description: Render the issuer mirror (templates/openfga-authn.yaml) that republishes the SA issuer's discovery and JWKS unauthenticated for OpenFGA; off only for a publicly served issuer.
Renders CPU-based HPAs for catalog and lineage. Needs metrics-server; off by default.

maxReplicas.description: HPA maximum replicas for catalog and lineage.

minReplicas.description: HPA minimum replicas for catalog and lineage.

scaleDownStabilizationSeconds.description: HPA scale-down stabilization window in seconds; stops a spiky service oscillating.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: HPA target CPU as a percentage of the pod's CPU request (not its limit).

dest.description: S3 URI the control-root backup is copied to. Empty writes `_backups/control/` inside the control root itself, which does not survive losing the bucket.

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that backs up the control root (project, warehouse, binding and bucket-claim registries). Off by default.

keep.description: Number of newest control-root backups kept after each successful copy; 0 keeps every run.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the control-root backup (default daily 01:00, ahead of the pg dump).

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that pg_dumps the lineage, OpenFGA and Dapr state databases (gzip) to `_backups/pg/<date>/` in the lakehouse bucket. Off by default.

keep.description: Number of newest daily pg dumps kept; older ones are pruned on each run.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the pg dump (default daily 02:00).

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that creates a CSI VolumeSnapshot of the lakehouse PVC; needs a CSI snapshotter and a VolumeSnapshotClass. Off by default.

kubectlImage.description: Image the snapshot job runs; it needs both a shell and kubectl.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the volume snapshot (default daily 03:00).

snapshotClassName.description: VolumeSnapshotClass the snapshot names; empty uses the cluster default.

controlEmit.description: Publish catalog control events (catalog.control.v1) on a broadcast Dapr topic; renders the control pubsub component, CATALOG_CONTROL stream and subscription. Best-effort.

bindingName.description: Name of the control relay's Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_CONTROL_RELAY_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves. Must stay one string.

enabled.description: Stage control events in a durable S3 outbox and run the relay cron that drains it; carries `table_published` to its subscribers. Requires `controlEmit`.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule of the control outbox relay; bounds how long a control event stays undelivered after a bus outage.

bindingName.description: Name of the erasure-release Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_ERASURE_RELEASE_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

deadlineDays.description: Days after an erasure obligation is recorded that it is due; an obligation still open past it is shown overdue (LANCE_ERASURE_DEADLINE_DAYS). Required.

releaseGraceDays.description: Days after an erasure blocked by a tag or branch pin, during which owners are told, before the pins are released (LANCE_ERASURE_RELEASE_GRACE_DAYS). Required.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which due erasure pin releases run; lateness only costs time.

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum request-body bytes on any catalog route (LANCE_MAX_BODY_BYTES); larger bodies get 413 before buffering. Default 256 MiB.

maxConcurrentWrites.description: Cap on concurrent in-flight Arrow-IPC writes; over it the catalog answers 429 + Retry-After. Peak buffer memory is this times `maxBodyBytes`. 0 disables shedding.

baseCredentialRefs.description: Map of data-base URI to a Dapr secret-store reference naming that base's credential. Every key must also be in `dataBases` or the render fails. Empty = estate options.

dataBases.description: Allowlist of bucket URIs one table's fragments may be spread across (`?data_base=` on create). Empty = multi-base off, single-location creates.

devSeed.description: Local fixture: create each referenced base's bucket, scoped MinIO user and dev-OpenBao secret. Refused on a real deployment, without MinIO or without the dev OpenBao.

bindingName.description: Name of the promotion-expiry Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_PROMOTION_EXPIRY_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which promotion holds past their review deadline expire; lateness only costs time.

trashGraceDays.description: Days a dropped table or namespace stays undroppable before the trash purge may reclaim it (LANCE_TRASH_GRACE_DAYS). 0 destroys immediately.

enabled.description: Per-warehouse physical multi-tenancy: POST /management/v1/warehouses provisions a bucket per warehouse and binds top-level namespaces to it. Unbound namespaces use `minio.bucket`.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region written to the fleet ConfigMap for S3 clients; any value works against RustFS/MinIO.

HCP_INSECURE.description: Skips TLS verification for the S3 client (`storage.client` reads it as an alias of RASK_S3_INSECURE). String "true" or "false".

RASK_API_PREFIX.description: Path prefix the fleet apps mount their API under, via the shared fleet ConfigMap.

apiTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline in seconds for every DaprClient gRPC call (DAPR_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), so a wedged sidecar fails a publish instead of hanging it.

controlPlaneNamespace.description: Namespace the Dapr control plane runs in; the Collector scrapes it and, under NetworkPolicy, every pod may reach it.

enabled.description: Deploy the Dapr dashboard web UI (templates/dapr-dashboard.yaml), reached by port-forward; requires `dapr.enabled`.

image.description: Container image for the Dapr dashboard Deployment.

enabled.description: Use Dapr: inject a daprd sidecar into every fleet and lakehouse pod and render rask's Components, Configurations and Resiliency. Needs a Dapr control plane (dapr.io/v1alpha1); the render refuses without it.

logLevel.description: daprd sidecar log level, stamped as the `dapr.io/log-level` annotation (debug, info, warn, error).

maxBodySize.description: Max request body for Dapr service invocation (`dapr.io/max-body-size`); Dapr's own default is 4Mi.

enabled.description: Render the Dapr Resiliency policy (sidecar retries, constant 120s x 4), per-app dead-letter topics, and the long broker backOff; false = broker-only.

cpuLimit.description: CPU limit for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-cpu-limit`).

cpuRequest.description: CPU request for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-cpu-request`).

memoryLimit.description: Memory limit for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-memory-limit`).

memoryRequest.description: Memory request for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-memory-request`).

sidecarRestricted.description: Add the RuntimeDefault seccomp annotation to daprd for PodSecurity `restricted`; also set the injector's `sidecarDropALLCapabilities`.

completed.description: How long a completed workflow's history is kept, as a positive h or m duration of at least 1h; default 168h (7 days).

enabled.description: Render a Dapr workflow `stateRetentionPolicy`, the only thing that purges workflow history; false means history grows unbounded.

failed.description: How long a failed workflow's history is kept for post-mortems, as a positive h or m duration of at least 1h; default 720h.

terminated.description: How long a terminated workflow's history is kept, as a positive h or m duration of at least 1h; default 720h (30 days).

clientId.description: The development Dex's static client id; also the audience services check (`RASK_OIDC_AUDIENCE`) and the client MinIO's OIDC provider uses.

clientSecret.description: The development Dex's static client secret (demo value); seeded into OpenBao as `publisher-oidc-client-secret`.

enabled.description: This estate uses the development Dex (deploy/fixtures/dex, Service `<release>-dex`): the ingress serves it at /dex, its publisher password is seeded into the dev store, and a real deployment refuses it. The chart renders no Dex.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL Dex serves and services trust (`RASK_OIDC_ISSUER`); a non-https issuer sets `RASK_OIDC_ALLOW_INSECURE=true`.

port.description: Port of the development Dex's Service.

password.description: Plain password of the publish saga's service account, seeded into OpenBao; must match the hash the development Dex holds (demo default `password`).

username.description: Login email of the publish saga's service account; the annotator mints a fresh token with it per publish.

enabled.description: Serves /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json on every app in the release, the gateway included. Off by default; turn on only for a dev cluster.

embedUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-shaped embedding server search calls and viewer probes (MEDIA_EMBED_URL). Empty = vector search modes report unavailable.

rerankUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-shaped reranker server (MEDIA_RERANK_URL). Empty = the rerank leg reports unavailable.

existingSecret.description: Name of a pre-made Secret used instead of the chart's `<release>-app` (object store access key ID and endpoint, never a credential). Empty renders `<release>-app`.

catalogUri.description: Catalog URL the explorer services use (MEDIA_CATALOG_URI). Empty = the in-release catalog Service.

controlEmit.description: Annotator publishes `task_assigned`/`task_unassigned` control events for the notifications inbox, and is scoped on the control pubsub component.

accessMode.description: Access mode of the chart-created corpus PVC; ReadWriteMany because three services read it concurrently.

claimName.description: Existing PVC to mount when mode is `pvc`. Empty = the chart creates `<release>-media-corpus` (kept on uninstall).

hostPath.description: Node directory mounted as the corpus when mode is `hostPath`.

mode.description: How the corpus volume is provided: `emptyDir` (default), `pvc` (existing `claimName` or a chart-created claim) or `hostPath` (DirectoryOrCreate).

size.description: Requested size of the chart-created corpus PVC.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the chart-created corpus PVC. Empty = the cluster's default StorageClass.

corpusMountPath.description: Path the corpus volume is mounted at, read-only, in all three explorer services.

corpusS3Root.description: S3 root (e.g. a warehouse bucket) the viewer serves the media corpus from (MEDIA_S3_DB_ROOT). Empty = the mounted corpus volume.

enabled.description: Deploy the explorer trio (viewer, search, annotator services) and their gateway URLs.

readBackend.description: Where the explorer services read annotations from (MEDIA_READ_BACKEND): `catalog` (governed) or `direct` (standalone dev).

annotator.description: Explorer annotator service: `port` and `daprAppId`; the app-id is scoped on the control pubsub when `explorer.controlEmit` is on.

search.description: Explorer search service: `port` (its HTTP port) and `daprAppId` (its Dapr app-id).

viewer.description: Explorer viewer service: `port` (its HTTP port) and `daprAppId` (its Dapr app-id).

writeBackend.description: Where the explorer services write annotations to (MEDIA_WRITE_BACKEND): `catalog` (governed) or `direct` (standalone dev).

kubernetesAuthPath.description: Mount path of the Vault/OpenBao Kubernetes auth backend the SecretStore authenticates through.

kvMount.description: Vault/OpenBao KV mount path the SecretStore reads from.

namespace.description: Namespace of the External Secrets Operator ServiceAccount the Vault role is bound to.

refreshInterval.description: How often each ExternalSecret re-syncs from the store (a duration, e.g. `1h`).

role.description: Vault role the operator's ServiceAccount assumes; also names its read policy.

secretPath.description: KV key holding the infra bundle (postgres-password, minio-secret-key), e.g. `lance` for secret/data/lance.

serviceAccount.description: Name of the External Secrets Operator ServiceAccount the Vault role is bound to, so no other pod can assume it.

forwardedAllowIps.description: Peers whose x-forwarded-* headers uvicorn trusts in every fleet pod (--forwarded-allow-ips). Set to the ingress controller's pod CIDR; `*` is refused.

apps.description: The zones to deploy: `name` (image `web-<name>`), `path` (/<name>) or `catchAll` for home at /, and an optional per-zone image `tag`.

bodySizeLimit.description: Request-body ceiling of each zone's Bun server (BODY_SIZE_LIMIT), kept above the BFF's 25 MB inference guard.

enabled.description: Deploy the SvelteKit zone servers, one Deployment and Service per entry in `frontend.apps`.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Bun server idle timeout per connection in seconds (0 to 255); 0 disables it so live query streams are not cut.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the zone containers; empty falls back to `image.pullPolicy`.

tag.description: Default image tag for every zone (an immutable commit tag); a zone overrides it with `tag` on its `apps` entry.

enabled.description: Per-user OIDC login shared across all zones; must move together with `auth.enabled` (templates/auth-consistency.yaml).

publicIssuer.description: Browser-reachable IdP issuer URL, e.g. https://auth.example.com/dex; required when `oidc.enabled`.

publicOrigin.description: Browser-reachable app origin, e.g. https://app.example.com; forms the /auth/callback redirect URI. Required when `oidc.enabled`.

runAsNonRoot.description: Pod-level securityContext for zone pods: refuse to start a container running as root.

replicas.description: Replicas per zone Deployment; above 1 the chart also renders a PodDisruptionBudget per zone.

resources.description: Default CPU and memory requests/limits per zone container, used when `resources.web-<zone>` is not set.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Container securityContext for zones: forbid privilege escalation.

capabilities.description: Container securityContext capabilities for zones; drops ALL Linux capabilities.

serveUrl.description: Ray Serve HTTP origin for zones that run inference; empty uses `ray.dashboardUrl`.

port.description: Port each zone's Bun server listens on and its Service exposes.

fullnameOverride.description: Base name for every rendered object; pinned to `rask` so in-cluster Services resolve as `rask-<component>`.

catalog.description: Lakehouse image (catalog, lineage, maintenance, media services): `repository` is the image name under image.repository, `tag` is required (empty fails the render).

digest.description: Global digest pin (sha256:...) for every first-party image; wins over `tag`. Empty uses tags.

digests.description: Per-component digest map keyed by component name; beats `tags` and the global tag.

localImages.description: Renders bare `<component>:<tag>` references for images side-loaded into the node (k3s-import). Never for a remote cluster.

repository.description: Registry prefix for every first-party image (e.g. ghcr.io/<org>/<repo>). Required unless localImages is true.

tag.description: Default tag for every first-party image when no per-component tag or digest is set.

tags.description: Per-component tag map keyed by component name (gateway, lance-rest-catalog, web-<zone>, ...); beats the global tag.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of pull Secrets ({name: ...}) added to every first-party pod and hook Job. Empty pulls anonymously.

annotations.description: Annotations merged onto the Ingress; defaults raise nginx proxy buffers to 16k, read/send timeouts to 3600 s and the body cap to 64m.

className.description: IngressClass name. Empty uses the cluster default (Traefik on k3s).

enabled.description: Renders the Ingress publishing `/` and `/api`. Only one release per cluster may hold a host-less Ingress.

host.description: Hostname the Ingress routes. Empty is a cluster-wide catch-all on `/` and `/api`.

tls.description: List of Ingress TLS entries ({secretName, hosts}). Empty serves plain HTTP.

maintenanceTerminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period in seconds for maintenance pods, long enough that an in-flight sweep or Lance write is not SIGKILLed.

preStopSeconds.description: Seconds every pod sleeps in preStop before SIGTERM, so endpoint removal propagates first.

sidecarBlockShutdownSeconds.description: Seconds the Dapr sidecar keeps running after SIGTERM to flush acks; must lie between preStopSeconds and the grace period.

teardownSeconds.description: Seconds reserved for the app's lifespan teardown; uvicorn's graceful-shutdown bound is grace - preStop - this.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod grace period in seconds; must be at least preStop + sidecar drain + 5 s buffer.

arrivalDlqTopic.description: Dead-letter topic of the write-event lane, for deliveries that exhaust their retries.

arrivalEnabled.description: Subscribe the write-event lane: expire the written table and refresh its due record between sweep ticks.

bindingName.description: Name of the Dapr cron binding that fires the sweep tick (`MAINTENANCE_BINDING_NAME`).

cloneListMaxAgeSeconds.description: Oldest clone list, in seconds, the catalog judges a compaction against and the write-event lane expires against.

controlEmit.description: Announce each reclamation on the catalog control topic (catalog.control.v1); needs Dapr sidecars. Off by default.

controlRoot.description: S3 root of the catalog's control registries (projects, warehouses, trash, `_bases/`). Empty uses the primary bucket; set together with the catalog's.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of the maintenance service; also names its durable consumer.

declaredPlatformRoots.description: Platform-owned store roots the catalog cannot resolve (e.g. medallion models) that the reconciler accounts for instead of reporting as unreadable.

discoveryMaxDepth.description: How deep the bucket walk descends looking for a dataset's `_versions/`; a subtree it stops inside is an IncompleteScan that blocks the purge.

driftRepair.description: Revoke OpenFGA tuples whose object no registry names (ghost projects/warehouses/tables); deletes tuples only. Off by default.

driftRepairDryRun.description: Plan and report drift repair without deleting any tuple. Defaults true.

driftRepairMaxPerTick.description: Maximum objects drift repair revokes per reconcile tick; the remainder is reported as capped and taken next tick.

enabled.description: Deploy the maintenance service (sweep, reconcile crons and the write-event lane).

floorRaise.description: Write one metadata-only commit per stranded dataset to raise its Lance listing floor so residue becomes reclaimable. Off by default.

floorRaiseDryRun.description: Plan and report floor raises without committing. Defaults true; set false to commit once `floorRaise` is on.

floorRaiseMaxPerTick.description: Maximum datasets the floor raise commits to per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

lineageEmit.description: Emit a lineage event per materially compacted dataset and a FAIL event per errored one; covers catalog-laid-out tables only.

minVersionsToExpire.description: Expiry runs on a table only once it has at least this many reclaimable versions.

olderThanDays.description: Days of version history kept by old-version GC.

orphanScan.description: Run the reconciler's per-dataset unreferenced-file scan; read-only, and required for `trashPurge` to certify a clean report.

policyRoot.description: S3 root of maintenance policy records. Empty falls back to `controlRoot`, then the primary bucket.

port.description: HTTP port of the maintenance container.

reconcileBindingName.description: Name of the Dapr cron binding that fires the drift reconciler (`MAINTENANCE_RECONCILE_BINDING_NAME`).

reconcileSchedule.description: Cadence of the drift reconciler, which only reads OpenFGA, the control-root registries and the bucket listing.

schedule.description: Backstop sweep cadence: writes the clone list and due records and expires unwritten tables; must stay under `cloneListMaxAgeSeconds`.

sweepBudgetSeconds.description: Wall-clock ceiling for one sweep tick, checked between datasets; 0 means unlimited.

tombstoneSweep.description: Clear trash records whose bytes a probe proves are gone; deletes bookkeeping rows, never bytes. Off by default.

tombstoneSweepDryRun.description: Plan and report the tombstone sweep without clearing anything. Defaults true.

tombstoneSweepMaxPerTick.description: Maximum trash records the tombstone sweep probes and clears per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

trashPurge.description: Delete the bytes of trash records past their grace deadline and revoke their grants, only when that tick's drift report is clean. Irreversible; off by default.

trashPurgeDryRun.description: Run the purge pass for real but perform no mutation, reporting `would_purge`; adds full read cost.

trashPurgeMaxPerTick.description: Maximum trash records purged per tick; the remainder is reported as capped and drained next tick.

tupleRebuild.description: Recreate OpenFGA tuples the control-plane registries still justify (project admin seed, warehouse tenancy); additive only. Off by default.

tupleRebuildDryRun.description: Plan and report the tuple rebuild without writing. Defaults true.

tupleRebuildMaxPerTick.description: Maximum tuples the rebuild writes per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

vendWriteCredentials.description: Sign maintenance's writes (version expiry) with a per-table credential vended by the catalog instead of the deployment's S3 key; falls back per dataset.

buckets.description: Map of tier namespace to S3 bucket (e.g. `{gold: lance-sink}`); unset namespaces use `minio.bucket`. Listed buckets are auto-created, swept by maintenance and reserved from warehouses.

accessKey.description: Access key id of the store's root account; its secret is the store's `minio-secret-key`. No service should present it.

bucket.description: The lakehouse root bucket (catalog `LANCE_REST_ROOT`, warehouse registry, lineage outbox).

buckets.description: Extra platform buckets the bucket-init Job creates and the reconcile exempts from orphan_buckets; governed tiers only, not the root or feature buckets.

catalogAccessKey.description: Access key of the catalog's scoped store identity; the secret derives in-cluster (`lance.scopedSecretFn`). Wide on data, no admin rights.

enabled.description: This estate uses the development object store (deploy/fixtures/minio, Service `<release>-minio`): rask runs its bucket-init Job and scoped-users hook against it and its dev store issues the root credential. Off with `externalEndpoint` set uses a managed S3. The chart renders no MinIO server.

externalEndpoint.description: S3 endpoint the apps use instead of the in-cluster MinIO; pair with `minio.enabled=false`. Empty uses the in-cluster store.

lineageAccessKey.description: Access key of the lineage service's scoped store identity (read-only plus deletes of its own outbox); secret derives in-cluster.

maintenanceAccessKey.description: Access key of maintenance's scoped store identity, the fallback when vending degrades; secret derives in-cluster.

enabled.description: The development store trusts Dex id_tokens for STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity (`vending.mode: web_identity`): ESO writes the Dex client secret it reads into `<release>-infra-credentials`. Turn on the fixture's `oidc.enabled` with it.

port.description: S3 API port of the development store's Service.

viewerAccessKey.description: Access key of the object browser's scoped identity (list and get only); secret derives in-cluster.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name used in `rask.name` labels when `fullnameOverride` is empty. Empty uses the chart name.

flagged.description: Extra user grants keyed by a values flag path, merged into `nats.auth.users` only while that flag is true (lance.natsTable).

provisioned.description: Attests the platform store holds every `nats-user-<user>`; required when the store is not the chart's dev OpenBao.

users.description: The bus user table, one user per Dapr app-id plus admin and monitor, each with publish and subscribe subject lists (never empty).

monitorUrl.description: HTTP monitoring endpoint of the bus (varz/jsz) the lakehouse zone's ops view reads (e.g. http://rask-nats-headless:8222). Empty hides the panel.

streamReplicas.description: Raft replica count for every stream the stream Job provisions; must not exceed the bus's node count.

url.description: NATS JetStream address every pub/sub component and the stream Job connect to (e.g. nats://nats.internal:4222). Required: empty fails the render.

enabled.description: Renders default-deny NetworkPolicies with explicit allows and exclusive client lists for the guarded stores. Needs a policy-enforcing CNI.

extraEgress.description: List of extra egress rules, verbatim NetworkPolicy entries, for external backends (off-cluster S3, managed NATS, external OTLP).

minioExtraFrom.description: List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach the object store.

openbaoExtraFrom.description: List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach OpenBao (e.g. the external-secrets namespace).

enabled.description: Deploy rask's OTel Collector and turn on OTLP export from the fleet, Dapr and OpenFGA to it; needs `export.endpoint`.

environment.description: Value of the `deployment.environment.name` OTel resource attribute; empty falls back to the release namespace.

auditHeaders.description: Headers added to the export of `lance.audit` records, which leave on their own exporter.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL the Collector exports traces, metrics and logs to (`/v1/traces` etc. are appended); the platform's backend. Required while `enabled`: empty fails the render.

traceHeaders.description: Headers added to the trace export.

image.description: Container image for the OTel Collector (contrib distribution).

auditTable.description: Table the audit viewer reads `lance.audit` records from; the same table `export.auditHeaders` routes them to.

url.description: Base URL of the store's SQL and PromQL API the zones read (GREPTIME_API); empty leaves those panels without data.

samplingRate.description: Dapr tracing sampling rate in the Dapr Configuration, as a string from 0 to 1; "1" traces every request.

devMode.description: The development store: in-memory, auto-unsealed with a fixed root token (demo only), run by the openbao fixture. False renders a sealed file-backed server an operator must init and unseal.

devToken.description: Root token of the development store (the openbao fixture's `devToken`), which the Dapr secret store presents when `devMode` is true.

enabled.description: An in-cluster OpenBao at `<release>-openbao`: with `devMode` the development store (deploy/fixtures/openbao), whose seed runs the scripts this chart renders (`<release>-openbao-seed`); without it the sealed server this chart renders.

externalAddr.description: Address of an external Vault/OpenBao the secret stores point at instead of the in-cluster server; pair with `openbao.enabled=false`.

image.description: OpenBao container image; also used by the MinIO scoped-users hook.

storage.description: PVC size of the file backend when `devMode` is false.

method.description: Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA API authentication method; `oidc` admits only projected ServiceAccount tokens.

audience.description: Token audience OpenFGA requires; templates/openfga-authn.yaml refuses a render unless it equals `lance.openfgaAudience` (rask-openfga).

issuer.description: Subchart passthrough (tpl-rendered): the OIDC issuer OpenFGA fetches keys from, the release's ServiceAccount issuer mirror.

datastore.description: Subchart passthrough: Postgres datastore on the AGE server, DSN from `rask-infra-credentials`, bundled migrations off (rask's Job migrates), pool 30 open/10 idle.

enabled.description: Install the OpenFGA authorization server subchart, plus rask's migrate Job, authn subject ConfigMap and PodDisruptionBudget for it.

extraEnvVars.description: Subchart passthrough env: OPENFGA_EXPERIMENTALS=weighted_graph_check, the OIDC issuer alias, and the subject allow-list from `rask-openfga-authn`.

http.description: Subchart passthrough: CORS for the OpenFGA HTTP API, closed by allowing only the unreachable origin `https://openfga.invalid`.

tag.description: OpenFGA image tag for the subchart server and for rask's own migrate Job (templates/openfga-migrate.yaml), so schema and binary match.

enabled.description: Subchart passthrough: the OpenFGA browser playground; off, since it only runs with authn `none`.

replicaCount.description: Subchart passthrough: number of OpenFGA server replicas.

resources.description: Subchart passthrough: CPU and memory requests/limits for the OpenFGA server.

telemetry.description: Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA OTLP tracing to the OTel Collector; off by default, ratio 0.001 because each Check emits ~1,900 spans.

enabled.description: Renders a PodDisruptionBudget for each service and zone running more than one replica.

controlName.description: Name of the broadcast (no queue group) Dapr pubsub component for catalog.control.v1; must match the catalog's LANCE_CONTROL_PUBSUB default. Used when `controlEmit` is on.

name.description: Name of the shared lineage publish Dapr pubsub component; each subscriber app gets a derived `<name>-<app-id>` component with its own queue group.

topic.description: Topic OpenLineage run events are published and subscribed on (LANCE_DAPR_TOPIC and siblings).

enabled.description: Renders `<release>-ray-auth-token` for the Ray engine and the compute fixture; the engine must enforce the same one. Off for dev.

dashboardUrl.description: Address of the engine's Ray dashboard, used verbatim by every Ray consumer; the ray-cluster fixture serves http://rask-ray-head-svc:8265.

enabled.description: rask talks to a Ray engine: the NetworkPolicy admits the pods KubeRay marks `ray.io/is-ray-node`, and the Collector scrapes them.

age.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the AGE Postgres StatefulSet (lineage and OpenFGA databases).

assist.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the assist model runner (two warm torch models).

catalog.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the catalog; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful.

default.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for every lakehouse app container that names no tier of its own (lance.resources).

fleet.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for fleet services (templates/fleet.yaml) that name no tier of their own.

lineage.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for lineage; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful.

otel-collector.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the OTel Collector; memory limit matches its hardcoded 400 MiB memory_limiter.

viewer.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the explorer viewer (in-process KG engine and atlas cache).

image.description: Assist runner image: `repository` and `tag`; the tag is required when runners are enabled.

port.description: HTTP port of the assist runner Service.

enabled.description: Deploy the `assist` model runner and point the annotator's MEDIA_ASSIST_URL at it instead of its in-repo mock.

jobsUrl.description: RayJob submit endpoint for the annotator's batch-labeling seam (MEDIA_JOBS_URL). Empty = the annotator keeps its submit/poll mock.

hfTokenInStore.description: True once the Hugging Face token is in the secret store at `<kvMount>/hf-token`; renders the `<release>-hf-token` ExternalSecret. False starts Ray pods without HF_TOKEN.

age.description: uid/fsGroup for the AGE Postgres pod (postgres image uid/gid 999).

enabled.description: Applies pinned runAsUser/fsGroup securityContexts to the infra pods (AGE, OpenBao). Off by default.

openbao.description: uid/fsGroup for the OpenBao pod (image uid 100).

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Read-only root filesystem for every first-party app container; each gets a writable /tmp emptyDir.

tmpSizeLimit.description: sizeLimit of each app's /tmp emptyDir (upload spool, Lance spill, OTel queue); stops one pod filling the node's disk.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of the catalog; also names its pubsub components and durable consumers.

module.description: uvicorn import path the catalog Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml).

port.description: Container and Service port of the Lance catalog.

replicas.description: Replica count of the catalog; above 1 requires catalog.controlEmit=true or the render fails.

frontDoor.description: Renders flows outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/flows to it.

governedAuth.description: Gives flows the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled; its run door checks the writer tier.

module.description: uvicorn import path the flows (studio flow-builder server) Deployment runs.

port.description: Container and Service port of the flows app.

replicas.description: Replica count of the flows Deployment; 0 scales it to zero.

waitFor.description: List of dependencies flows waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled).

frontDoor.description: Renders the gateway outside singleTenant; it is the /api entry point.

healthPath.description: Liveness probe path of the gateway (default `/livez`).

module.description: uvicorn import path the gateway Deployment runs.

port.description: Container and Service port of the gateway (the /api reverse proxy the Ingress routes to).

readyPath.description: Readiness probe path of the gateway (default `/readyz`); it asks no upstream, so the gateway stays Ready without backends.

replicas.description: Replica count of the gateway Deployment; 0 scales it to zero.

waitFor.description: List of dependencies the gateway waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled).

ageStatementTimeoutSeconds.description: Server-side per-statement timeout in seconds on lineage's AGE pool; bounds a runaway Cypher traversal.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of lineage; also names its pubsub, DLQ and durable consumers and scopes its reconcile cron.

demoData.description: Mounts the unauthenticated /demo/* data-peek router. Demo only; off by default.

eventsRetentionDays.description: Days of arrival time the durable /events feed keeps, pruned on the reconcile tick; bounds how long a notifications outage it survives. 0 is unbounded.

freshnessBudgetHours.description: Hours after which a dataset with no new version is flagged `stale` by reconcile and the dataset GET. 0 turns the check off.

module.description: uvicorn import path the lineage Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml).

enabled.description: Stages each lineage event to `s3://<minio.bucket>/_lineage_outbox` before publishing, drained by reconcile. Requires reconcile.enabled.

port.description: Container and Service port of the lineage service.

readAudit.description: Records every allowed FGA-gated data read (feeds GET /datasets/{name}/readers). Rendered only when auth.enabled.

bindingName.description: Name of the reconcile cron binding; the sidecar POSTs to /<bindingName>.

enabled.description: Renders the storage-to-graph reconcile cron, which back-fills lost lineage events, drains the outbox and prunes. Needs dapr.enabled.

schedule.description: Schedule of the reconcile sweep (Dapr cron syntax, e.g. `@every 300s` or a cron expression).

replicas.description: Replica count of lineage; replicas form a competing-consumer group, so it scales freely.

runRetentionDays.description: Days after which reconcile prunes graph :Run nodes and the Dataset nodes that leaves orphaned. 0 keeps everything.

enabled.description: Renders the `notifications-email` Dapr SMTP binding and adds `email` to RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_CHANNELS. Off by default.

from.description: Sender address the email channel sends from.

host.description: SMTP server host for the email channel.

port.description: SMTP server port for the email channel (default 587).

secretName.description: Secret-store key holding the SMTP `user` and `password` fields.

enabled.description: Renders the Slack Dapr binding and adds `slack` to RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_CHANNELS. Off by default.

secretName.description: Secret-store key holding the Slack `webhookUrl` field.

daprIngest.description: Renders APP_API_TOKEN for notifications, which refuses to start with Dapr on and no token.

frontDoor.description: Renders notifications outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/notifications to it.

governedAuth.description: Gives notifications the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled.

identityAudiences.description: Audiences of the service-account tokens projected into the notifications pod, one per door it calls (rask-lineage).

module.description: uvicorn import path the notifications (inbox) Deployment runs.

port.description: Container and Service port of the notifications app.

reconcileBindingName.description: Name of the reconcile cron binding; also rendered as RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_BINDING_NAME so the tick reaches the matching route.

reconcileSchedule.description: Schedule of the reconcile cron over lineage's /events feed; must stay above the app's 25 s reconcile budget.

replicas.description: Replica count of the notifications Deployment; replicas form a competing-consumer group. 0 scales it to zero.

waitFor.description: List of dependencies notifications waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled).

doors.description: Mode of the bus doors' signature check: "off", "observe" (count would-refuse) or "enforce" (ack and refuse). Always quoted.

enforce.description: Lineage refuses unsigned or non-verifying events when the secret store and auth are also on. False renders no signer sets and lineage verifies nothing.

mintImage.description: Image of the dev OpenBao's `mint` init container that generates each identity's NKEY pair.

provisioned.description: Attest that signing keys exist for every identity in a non-dev store; the render fails until it is true there.

enabled.description: Renders the single-tenant default workloads (every fleet service, domain zones). False installs front-door services only; the object store is gated by `minio.enabled`.

componentVersion.description: Version of the Dapr Postgres state store component.

enabled.description: Render the Dapr Postgres state store component (actor and workflow state) on the AGE `stateDb`.

metadataTableName.description: Table the Dapr state store keeps its own metadata in.

name.description: Name of the Dapr state store component.

scopes.description: App-ids allowed to load the state store; the secret-store scope is derived from this list too. Adding one needs a restart of scoped pods.

secretStore.description: Dapr secret store that resolves the state store's connection string (OpenBao, never a k8s Secret).

tableName.description: Postgres table holding Dapr state rows.

stores.description: Object-store registry rendered as RASK_STORES for the fleet and the explorer viewer; each entry is {name, bucket, role, secret, description, endpoint?, insecure?}, `secret` a Dapr secret-store key.

allowExternalBlobs.description: Allow blob-v2 columns to reference arbitrary external objects (Blob.from_uri) on create. Off by default: an SSRF and dangling-pointer risk; prefer `externalBlobBases`.

assumeRoleArn.description: Role ARN passed on AssumeRole in `sts`/`web_identity` mode (LANCE_S3_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN); stores with inherited policies ignore it but boto3 requires it.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption for direct writes, carried in vended storage options: `algorithm` (AES256, aws:kms, aws:kms:dsse) and `kmsKeyId` (kms only). Empty = bucket default.

endpoint.description: Object-store endpoint every vended credential names (LANCE_S3_VENDED_ENDPOINT). Empty = the catalog's own store endpoint.

externalBlobBases.description: Comma-separated allowlist of base URIs external blob pointers may live under (LANCE_EXTERNAL_BLOB_BASES). Empty = `s3://<minio.bucket>/models/`; a value replaces that default.

mode.description: How the catalog vends storage credentials for direct object I/O: `mode_b` (none, server-mediated), `web_identity`, `sts` (default, scoped AssumeRole) or `static`.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of a vended STS / web-identity credential (LANCE_VENDING_TTL_SECONDS).
